commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent full-body hero portrait for Bomb Hero Bits, a premium cute chibi pixel-fantasy RPG character collection. Style: polished collectible anime JRPG chibi character, approximately 2.4 heads tall, oversized head and eyes, tiny compact body and short legs, stylish original outfit, highly appealing personality. Crisp stepped pixel-like outlines and carefully placed cel-shading clusters, rich jewel colors and concentrated highlights, game character selection illustration. NOT realistic, NOT a smooth 3D render, no painterly blur. Clean coherent dark outline, extremely readable silhouette at 160px. Composition: full body head-to-toe standing pose, slight three-quarter front view, character centered and occupies 82% of canvas height with clear transparent margins on all sides. Every weapon, accessory and hair tip fully inside frame. Single character only. Genuinely transparent alpha background. No card border, no rarity badge, no text or lettering, no numbers, no logo, no scenery, no floor plane, no pedestal, no drop-shadow blob or unrelated floating particles. All portraits belong to one coherent chibi RPG collection. Subject:
